text:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing error spikes from canary in eu-west-1, 5xx rate up ~12% over baseline. I'm putting today's rollout on hold.
maria: tagging @kevin @sam for rollback + reschedule decision.
deploybot: [automated] scheduled deploy 2765012000 to orbit-service -> status: HOLD (reason: incident: eu-west-1 canary errors)
sam: copied logs, thx. Can we pin current canary to v1.14.2 while we investigate?
kevin: +1 pin. We shouldn't introduce new model/quant changes until we have root cause.
maria: Agree. Maria -> ops: pin deploy slot B to v1.14.2 for next 24h. Also need a checklist to safely swap slots for the requeue.
elaine: Ops checklist idea: (1) pin image, (2) clear KV cache on canary hosts, (3) run smoke tests (--path /health) x5, (4) scale down new slots before redeploy.
sam: Add: preserve current routing weight at 0.1 during smoke. Don't jump to 1.0.
kevin: If we need rollback, plan is: immediate revert to previous commit sha: a1b2c3d4, abort any DB migrations, rollback config flags.
devops-bot: @maria acknowledged. Creating a pinned alias: orbit-service:canary -> v1.14.2 (expires in 24h)
maria: OK. Who's owner for the redeploy slot swap? volunteer?
sam: I can run the swap and smoke tests. Will coordinate with infra.
kevin: I'll own the rollback playbook and watch the metrics during canary.
sam: Steps I'll run in order:
```
1) mark deploy slot B as drained
2) set alias orbit-service:canary -> v1.14.2
3) restart canary pods (one at a time)
4) run health check script: ./ci/check_canary.sh --retries 5
5) confirm partial traffic 10% for 15 mins -> 25% for 30 mins -> 100% only if stable
```
maria: Good. Timebox? aiming for a safe requeue tomorrow 08:00 UTC. If anything looks off, we abort and keep hold.
deploybot: scheduling redeploy window request created: window=2026-04-14T08:00:00Z -> request id: 7721 (pending approvals).
elaine: I'll run KV cache purge pre-swap and collect fresh traces.
kevin: Also add a regression eval on the promptset with the quantized path — just in case.
maria: Thanks all. Sam, ping here when you start and paste smoke output. We'll update release notes to reflect the hold and next window. :white_check_mark:
